title: Hentown Obsidian Vault Schema (Simplified)
description: Minimal JSON Schema for validating frontmatter in vault notes. Only essential fields: type, created, project, status.

type.description: The file class type. Determines vault location and expected purpose.

created.description: Creation date in YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS format.

project.description: Wikilink to the project hub note, e.g., [[chatterbox]]. Required for files under 10-Projects/.

original_path.description: Path to the original source file before migration. Breadcrumb for audit trail.

status.description: Status of this item (free-form text, e.g., 'planned', 'in-progress', 'completed'). Extract from body if present.
